explanation: This unit is low at GO (0-1, or 2-4 if the agent has been choosing a2 for many trials in a row, most often early in the episode) and high at D1 (usually 6-8, 9-10 during a long run of a2 choices that are being rewarded, and only 3-5 late in the episode while the agent is choosing a1). At D2 it is 8-9 when a2 was chosen, about 6 for a1 choices early in the episode, and 2-4 for a1 choices after about trial 60, with a slight further drop after a rare transition on a1 trials.
